entries.name: Stout Resilience

texts.fr: Tu bénéficies d’un avantage aux jets de sauvegarde contre le poison et d’une résistance aux dégâts de poison.

entries.name: Age
entries: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.

entries.name: Size
entries: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Lucky
entries: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

entries.name: Brave
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling. The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. They write very little, so they don't have a rich body of literature. Their oral tradition, however, is very strong. Almost all halflings speak Common to converse with the people in whose lands they dwell or through which they are traveling.

entries.name: Age
entries: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Size
entries: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects. They are fond of sprinkling their speech with words borrowed from other tongues: Orc curses, Elvish musical expressions, Dwarvish military phrases, and so on.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild

texts.fr: Tu as la maîtrise de {@item longsword|phb}, {@item shortsword|phb}, {@item shortbow|phb} et {@item longbow|phb}.
Ta vitesse de marche de base passe à 35 pieds.
Tu peux tenter de te cacher même lorsque tu n’es que légèrement dissimulé par le feuillage, une pluie battante, la neige qui tombe, la brume ou d’autres phénomènes naturels.

entries.name: Age
entries: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to encompass worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

entries.name: Size
entries: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Trance
entries: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.
{@note If you meditate during a long rest, you finish the rest after only 4 hours. You otherwise obey all the rules for a long rest; only the duration is changed.}

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish. Elvish is fluid, with subtle intonations and intricate grammar. Elven literature is rich and varied, and their songs and poems are famous among other races. Many bards learn their language so they can add Elvish ballads to their repertoires.

entries.name: Elf Weapon Training
entries: You have proficiency with the {@item longsword|phb}, {@item shortsword|phb}, {@item shortbow|phb}, and {@item longbow|phb}.

entries.name: Fleet of Foot
entries: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

items.name: Age
entries: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens. Most human initiates have completed the trials and found a glorious or inglorious death before they turn 30. Viziers can enjoy longer service to their gods, in theory living up to a century.

items.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice.

items.name: Alignment
entries: Humans tend toward no particular alignment. The best and the worst are found among them.

texts.fr: Tu obtiens la maîtrise d’une compétence de ton choix.
Tu obtiens un {@5etools don|feats.html} de ton choix.

Les humains deviennent adultes à la fin de l’adolescence. La plupart des initiés ont terminé les épreuves et trouvé une mort glorieuse ou peu glorieuse avant 30 ans. Les vizirs peuvent servir leurs dieux plus longtemps, vivant en théorie jusqu’à un siècle.
Tu sais parler, lire et écrire le commun et une autre langue de ton choix.
Les humains ne tendent vers aucun alignement particulier. On trouve parmi eux le meilleur comme le pire.

entries.name: Age
entries: Like humans, aven reach adulthood in their late teens and can theoretically live into their 80s. Of course, most find a glorious (or inglorious) death long before that point.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most aven lean toward some form of neutrality. Ibis-headed aven, focused more on knowledge than any other virtue, are usually neutral. Hawk-headed aven are inclined toward lawful neutral.

entries.name: Size
entries: Aven stand from 5 to 6 feet tall, but their bodies are slender and their bones are partially hollow to facilitate their flight. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a flying speed of 30 feet. You can't use your flying speed while you wear medium or heavy armor. (If your campaign uses the variant rule for encumbrance, you can't use your flying speed if you are encumbered.)

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Aven.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Keldons tend toward chaotic alignments, and many walk a fine line between good and evil.

entries.name: Size
entries: Keldons are taller and heavier than the human norms of other cultures, standing almost universally above 6 feet tall and reaching heights above 7 feet. Your size is Medium.

entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and {@language Keldon|PSD}.

entries.name: Natural Athlete
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} skill.

entries.name: Keldon Resilience

texts.fr: Les Keldes atteignent l’âge adulte vers la fin de leur adolescence et vivent moins d’un siècle.
Les Keldes tendent vers les alignements chaotiques, et beaucoup avancent sur une ligne ténue entre le bien et le mal.
Les Keldes sont plus grands et plus lourds que les humains habituels des autres cultures, mesurant presque tous plus de 6 pieds et pouvant dépasser 7 pieds. Ta catégorie de taille est Moyenne.
Tu sais parler, lire et écrire le commun et le {@language Keldon|PSD}.
Tu as la maîtrise de la compétence {@skill Athletics}.
Tu maîtrises les jets de sauvegarde de Force.
Tu es naturellement adapté aux {@hazard Extreme Cold|DMG|climats froids}, comme décrit au chapitre 5 du {@i Guide du maître}.

review.reason: Correction grammaticale en « aux climats froids » ; adaptation naturelle, référence de danger et chapitre 5 du Guide du maître restent intacts.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Humans tend toward no particular alignment.

entries.name: Size
entries: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice.

entries.name: Fleet of Foot
entries: Your ground speed increases to 35 feet.

entries.name: Mask of the Wild
entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

texts.fr: Ta vitesse au sol passe à 35 pieds.
Tu peux tenter de te cacher même lorsque tu n’es que légèrement dissimulé par le feuillage, une pluie battante, la neige qui tombe, la brume ou d’autres phénomènes naturels.

entries.name: Age
entries: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to encompass worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Elves love freedom, variety, and self-expression, so they lean strongly toward the gentler aspects of chaos. They value and protect others' freedom as well as their own, and they are more often good than not.

entries.name: Size
entries: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Elf Weapon Training
entries: You have proficiency with the {@item longsword|phb}, {@item shortsword|phb}, {@item shortbow|phb}, and {@item longbow|phb}.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Trance
entries: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.
{@note If you meditate during a long rest, you finish the rest after only 4 hours. You otherwise obey all the rules for a long rest; only the duration is changed.}

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish. Elvish is fluid, with subtle intonations and intricate grammar. Elven literature is rich and varied, and their songs and poems are famous among other races. Many bards learn their language so they can add Elvish ballads to their repertoires.

entries: Your ground speed increases to 35 feet.

entries.name: Age
entries: Merfolk mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20. They live considerably longer than humans, though, often reaching well over 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most merfolk are neutral, though merfolk of the Emeria and Cosi creeds have chaotic leanings.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Size
entries: Merfolk are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Swimming
entries: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

entries: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} (if it exists in your campaign), {@language Merfolk|PSX}, and one additional language of your choice.

texts.fr: Tu connais un sort mineur de ton choix dans la {@filter liste de sorts de druide|spells|class=Druid|level=0}. La Sagesse est ta caractéristique d’incantation pour ce sort.
Tu peux tenter de te cacher même lorsque tu n’es que légèrement dissimulé par le feuillage, une pluie battante, la neige qui tombe, la brume ou d’autres phénomènes naturels.
Tu sais parler, lire et écrire le {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} (s’il existe dans ta campagne), le {@language Merfolk|PSX} et une langue supplémentaire de ton choix.

limits: Une référence consultable n'active aucun effet automatique.

entries.name: Age
entries: Merfolk mature at the same rate humans do and reach adulthood around the age of 20. They live considerably longer than humans, though, often reaching well over 100 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most merfolk are neutral, though merfolk of the Emeria and Cosi creeds have chaotic leanings.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Size
entries: Merfolk are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Swimming
entries: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} (if it exists in your campaign), {@language Merfolk|PSX}, and one additional language of your choice.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most goblins are wildly chaotic, with no particular inclination toward good or evil but a strong tendency toward mischief.

entries.name: Agile Climber
entries: You have a climbing speed of 25 feet. You can't use your climbing speed while you wear medium or heavy armor. (If your campaign uses the variant rule for {@variantrule encumbrance|PHB}, you can't use your climbing speed if you are encumbered.)

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} (if it exists in your campaign) and {@language Goblin|PHB}.

texts.fr: La plupart des gobelins sont follement chaotiques, sans inclination particulière pour le bien ou le mal, mais avec un goût prononcé pour les espiègleries.

Tu possèdes une vitesse d’escalade de 25 pieds. Tu ne peux pas l’utiliser en armure intermédiaire ou lourde. Si ta campagne utilise la variante de {@variantrule encumbrance|PHB}, tu ne peux pas utiliser cette vitesse d’escalade lorsque tu es encombré.
Tu sais parler, lire et écrire le {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common}, s’il existe dans ta campagne, et le {@language Goblin|PHB}.

entries.name: Age
entries: Goblins mature faster than humans, reaching adulthood at around age 12. They also age noticeably faster than humans, and even the most cautious goblins rarely live longer than 50 years.

entries.name: Alignment
entries: Most goblins are wildly chaotic, with no particular inclination toward good or evil but a strong tendency toward mischief.

entries.name: Size
entries: Goblins average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Thanks to your heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write {@language Common Trade Pidgin|PSX|Common} (if it exists in your campaign) and {@language Goblin|PHB}.

entries.name: Grit
entries: You have resistance to fire damage and psychic damage. In addition, when you are wearing no armor, your AC is equal to 11 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Agile Climber
entries: You have a climbing speed of 25 feet. You can't use your climbing speed while you wear medium or heavy armor. (If your campaign uses the variant rule for {@variantrule encumbrance|PHB}, you can't use your climbing speed if you are encumbered.)
